description: Dodge Blocks — steer your square past the falling blocks on canvas. Survive as long as you can.

faqs.a: Arrow keys or A/D to move (WASD works too). On touch screens, drag your finger across the game.
Blocks fall faster and spawn more often the longer you survive.
Your longest survival time is saved in your browser.

howto: Move left/right with arrow keys (or drag on touch).
Dodge every falling block — one hit ends the run.
Survive as long as possible for a high score.
title: Dodge Blocks
